observations.behavior: Adds three histogram bucket values (750.0, 1500.0, 2000.0, 3000.0) and a comment explaining the choice, while retaining the original buckets.
observations.posthog_connection: These buckets are used by the ClickHouse histogram for the logs volume tick latency metric, which records the duration of the discovery query. The comment states the buckets are chosen to avoid boundary effects when the query latency falls between 750ms and 3s, and to support accurate high-quantile interpolation.
